thread:
maria: Thanks everyone — couple quick follow-ups from today's security section (SOC2 / ISO / KMS / VPC). Can we do a quick sync here so we have actionable owners?

maria: Top questions I heard: 1) BYOK/KMS timeline for Private customers, 2) audit log retention & export options, 3) VPC connectivity modes & egress controls, 4) who owns the evidence collection/playbook for audits?

raj: Short answers to start: BYOK pilot is targeted for late Q3, GA in Q4 (target dates still depend on HSM vendor timeline). Audit logs default retention is 90 days; enterprise add-on supports up to 1 year today. VPC: we support VPC peering today and are adding PrivateLink in the next sprint. Evidence playbook ownership: elena (security) to lead, product + infra will partner.

elena: I can own the playbook. I'll put together a checklist for SOC2/ISO evidence and a runnable runbook for Dedicated/Private. Need help from infra for KMS/HSM specifics and from product for API surface.

sophia: Product here — we'll provide the list of API calls and data flows that auditors typically ask for. Also can document which routes produce PII-sensitive logs so we can mark them in the playbook.

andy: On KMS/HSM bits — current plan is to support vendor A HSM for the BYOK pilot. Key rotation will be customer-triggered or automated (customer chooses) with a 30-day key rollover window to allow syncing across instances. For Private customers we'll expose a config flag.

jake: Question: for Dedicated customers who want long-term retention, can we just export audit logs to their S3 with server-side encryption?

elena: Yes. We already have an audit-export feature (beta). Customers can route logs to a customer-owned S3/GCS bucket with SSE and lifecycle rules. We'll document required IAM policies.

jake: Example CLI snippet for the beta export:
```
redwood audit export enable --dest s3://acme-redwood-logs --kms-key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd1234 --retention 365
```

elena: That CLI is close — final flags may change, but the flow is correct. Also note that audit exports must be configured before the retention window is enforced; we'll add validation.

maria: For VPC options: can someone confirm whether PrivateLink will support cross-account access or if customers should use peering?

andy: PrivateLink will support cross-account access in the initial rollout. For large-scale networks peering remains an option. We'll publish a decision matrix (latency, throughput, cost).

raj: Action items I propose: 1) elena to own playbook + draft by next Wednesday, 2) andy to produce KMS/HSM integration doc + rotation options by EOW, 3) sophia to surface required API artifacts for auditors by next Tuesday, 4) infra to add a short doc on audit-export IAM template. I'll follow up in PRs. :thumbsup:

elena: I'll create a repo under compliance/playbooks and invite reviewers.

sophia: I'll drop a short list of endpoints and sample evidence files into the playbook repo.

jake: I'll start a template S3 policy and attach it to the playbook repo as well.

audit-bot: Reminder: SOC2 sprint checklist item created and assigned to @elena. Due: 1905844676.

maria: Perfect — thanks all. If anyone needs a hand with evidence gathering or test data for auditors ping me or @sophia.

maria: Closing note — please keep questions short here and move detailed technical follow-ups to the playbook PRs so we don't spam the main channel.
